ITEM 1 | Half-moon slice of yellow corn cob, bright yellow kernels with pale cream interior, cut face flat and dry, sits at upper left of plate, about 6 cm long and 3.5 cm thick | 60
ITEM 2 | Rectangular slice of flatbread-like crust with red tomato sauce spread over most of it, orange-red glossy sauce, pale golden crust edges, a pale cream-colored wedge on top and small green herb sprigs scattered over it, about 9 cm by 5 cm and 1 cm thick | 90
ITEM 3 | Mixed leafy salad with dark green spinach-like and lighter frilly leaves, orange shredded carrot strands, thin sliced pink-and-white radish rounds, red tomato wedges, and small white crumbled cheese or seed bits, lightly dressed with a moist sheen, piled in a mound about 9 cm across and 3 cm tall on the right side of the plate | 85
ITEM 4 | Cubes of grilled eggplant, dark purple skin with browned and charred grill marks on cut faces, soft translucent-looking flesh, glossy with a little oil, scattered in a loose cluster about 10 cm long at the lower right, pieces roughly 2 to 3 cm each | 110
ITEM 5 | Small pale tan-to-beige smear or dollop of creamy spread with slightly crumbly edges sitting on the tomato slice near the center-left, about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide | 15
ITEM 6 | Thin light oil or dressing sheen pooling in small patches on the plate near the eggplant and salad, clear to pale golden, no defined shape | 5
